content: Insults and expressions of contempt, which include: Animal analogy, ex: يا كلب> (“yA klb” – “O dog”) and كل تبن> (“kl tbn” – “eat hay”).; Insult to family members, ex: يا روح أمك> (“yA rwH Amk” – “O mother's soul”); Sexually-related insults, ex: يا ديوث> (“yA dywv” – “O person without envy”); Damnation, ex: الله يلعنك> (“Allh ylEnk” – “may Allah/God curse you”); and Attacks on morals and ethics, ex: يا كاذب> (“yA kA*b” – “O liar”)
